transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... lately I've been feeling a lot more tense and down than I expected. I recently tried to clean up my image and my daily routine for some arts board stuff I'm involved in, and it's just been hard. 

I mean, I'm still doing the basics, but I keep dropping little things that I normally care a lot about—like my fair planning notes or design drafts. And then I just feel really guilty about falling behind, so I end up canceling plans with people instead of actually trying to catch up.
How long have you been feeling this tense and down?
I'd say it's been going on for about two months. Yeah, roughly two months... it started right around the time I began trying to overhaul my daily routine and my presentation.
Over these past two months, have you felt down or low nearly every day, for most of the day?

No, I wouldn't say it's every day, or even most of the day. It's more just... when I think about all the things I'm supposed to be doing, or when I look at the stuff I've dropped. Then I feel really down. But there are days where I feel okay, or at least not totally low. It just comes and goes depending on what's going on.
Did a specific major life event or major stress happen right before these symptoms started?

Yeah, I think the main thing was... well, I started feeling this way a few weeks after I began changing my clothes, my routines, and who I was spending time with. It was all for that arts board image reset I mentioned earlier. That was really the only major change right before this all started.
Have you ever experienced episodes of low mood or anxiety like this in the past, before these recent changes?
No, I really haven't. I mean, I've had normal stress before, like anyone else, but never anything like this where I feel so tense and down for weeks. This is definitely new for me.
